source_assessments.reason: The source's two-route coverage is accurate, but its product-level No Elements claim contradicts the separate method documentation and its description could trigger fulfillment on a scan rather than verified payment.

answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/promptpay/accept-a-payment identifies PromptPay as a Thai instant-transfer service and links Checkout and Direct API (new raw lines 5-14). The selector provides no integration prerequisites, payment steps or state transitions. The May 6 guide describes a merchant-created Checkout Session for Thai businesses, one-time same-currency THB line items, payment mode only, and dynamic or manual selection (old raw lines 12-50). In Direct API the merchant server creates a PaymentIntent and supplies the client secret. The buyer's email is the billing field in the shown custom form; Stripe.js confirms, displays a QR, and the buyer authenticates the payment in their banking/payment app. Upon completion the PaymentIntent reaches succeeded and emits payment_intent.succeeded for fulfillment (old raw lines 143-165, 230-250 and 275-310). source-stripe-promptpay-accept-payment.md preserves the two bodies and webhook advice but miscasts the scan or modal closure as a definitive outcome, and mistakes the absence of a standalone Elements variant for lack of product support.
answers.Q2: The November change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/promptpay/accept-a-payment is presentation/navigation only (new raw lines 9-14) and supplies no substantive product change. Retain May 6, 2026 Checkout compatibility and payment-only scope, THB one-time line items, and the Direct API new-method example's email field, authentication and verified outcome (old raw lines 20-50, 230-250 and 275-310). Correct source-stripe-promptpay-accept-payment.md so the two covered acceptance paths do not negate Elements product support, described in the separate May and November method captures with Express Checkout Element excluded and Mobile Payment Element scoped to iOS. Keep that overview's send_invoice Invoicing/Subscriptions qualification separate from Checkout modes and the November US account waitlist private preview separate from the May Thai Checkout scope. A QR rescan can deduct funds again in the separate method documentation. Retain root index line 7, Stripe index lines 362-363 and 748, and Real-Time Payments concept line 211 with a source backlink and a separately dated navigation reference.
